messages:
ivy: Heads-up: I'm proposing a small change to sampling for high-cardinality routes (user IDs / order refs). Instead of storing prefixes that leak identifiers, store per-request pseudonyms + route-scoped fingerprint and sample at a rate cap. idea: pseudonymize before any retention.
noah: Clarify: pseudonymize = deterministic one-way mapping (HMAC with tenant key) so we can group incidents but not recover raw ids? :thumbsup:
ivy: yes — HMAC(tenant_key, route_namespace, id) truncated to 12 bytes. store only pseudonym, prefix up to 64 bytes of non-id text. no raw ids, no vectors.
ravi: What's the impact on our retention index? If we pseudonymize we lose ability to search by plaintext, but we can search by pseudonym if customer gives original id (and we re-hash locally). OK tradeoff. Need to document in console.
tess: UX ask: show "pseudonymized" badge and a small explanation: "Requests are stored with non-reversible pseudonyms. Provide original id to correlate." Include link to legal text.
ivy: Spoke to legal: they want consent language for opt-in and an audit trail for any time support re-hashes a value. Also breakglass must require customer-signed consent to reveal raw payload.
sec-bot: security-scan: require monthly client-key rotation + KMS access logs (ticket SEC-4801). Also flag potential collision risk when truncating to 12 bytes; add collision test.
noah: Ops: add per-tenant retention budget metric so high-cardinality tenants can't exhaust storage. If cap hit, fallback to dropping retention and emit retention.drop.metric. Also alert ops at 5% remaining.
ravi: Implementation note: preprocessing pipeline should detect embeddings/outputs and drop them before pseudonymization. If route = embeddings, noop retention.
tess: For Console: add a small card on route settings: retention tier, pseudonymization enabled flag, current window usage, "request temporary bump" button (SSO approval required). Mockups incoming.
ivy: We should also separate retained telemetry from billing: retained artifacts must not be treated as billable tokens. Noah can own a ledger patch.
noah: I'll own billing separation + tests to make sure usage metrics unaffected. Will add unit & integration tests.
sec-bot: note: breakglass flow must be gated by RBAC group 'support-debug' and require justification + approver SSO. log must record approver id, request id, and TTL. ticket SEC-4802.
ops-bot: canary: schedule pseudonymize-canary to small canary pool Thu 04:00 UTC.
ravi: Tests: collision probability test, per-tenant cap churn test, embed-strip regression, breakglass audit e2e. I'll add them to the CI matrix.
tess: Also add a small inline tooltip: "Why this matters: reduces leakage risk for high-cardinality identifiers." legal approved copy pending.
ivy: plan: I'll open RFC + PR with middleware + console flags + test plan. If no objections, aim for canary next week.
noah: sgtm.
sec-bot: please include SEC tickets in the PR description.
ivy: thanks all — moving this to a PR and adding docs. Follow-ups in this thread.
